dial.summary: BTC dominance eased slightly to 59.4% but remains firmly above the 55% alt-rotation threshold; DXY pulled back to 101.77 yet real yields ticked up to 2.80%, sustaining a macro headwind backdrop; low funding rates (0.0079% per 8h) and stable Global M2 at $103.7T confirm low-leverage spot accumulation in BTC ahead of the October 28 FOMC decision.

indicators.name: Global Liquidity (Global M2)
indicators.note: MacroMicro G4 M2 aggregate (Fed/ECB/BOJ/PBOC) unchanged at ~$103.7T for August 2026 (latest month with all four economies reporting; July $102.64T → August $103.66T, +$1.02T, +1.0% MoM); US M2 at $23.34T for August (FRED H.6, up 5.7% YoY); September G4 aggregate still unavailable (6–8 week reporting lag); 4-week trend remains UP; status supportive (4-week trend is up); next full G4 update expected mid-November 2026.

indicators.name: ISM Manufacturing PMI
indicators.note: September 2026 ISM Manufacturing PMI at 54.5% (released Oct 1, 2026; August 54.6%, 4-week change −0.1pp within flat threshold); ninth consecutive month above 50; New Orders 55.3, Production 56.7, Prices Paid 77.9% (multi-year high); October PMI release scheduled November 2, 2026 at 10:00 AM ET; status neutral (above 50 but not rising on 4-week basis).

indicators.name: DXY (US Dollar Index)
indicators.note: ICE DXY spot at ~101.77 (Oct 20, 2026 close per Trading Economics: 101.7694, −0.21% on the day); 4-week trend UP from ~100.29 on Sep 18 (+1.5%); pulled back from Oct 19 high of ~102.07; 52-week range 95.55–102.95; status headwind (above 100 threshold); FOMC Oct 28 decision could extend DXY toward 103+ on a 25bp hike.

indicators.name: Real Yields (US10Y - CPI)
indicators.note: 10-year TIPS real yield (DFII10) at 2.80% as of October 19, 2026 (Fed H.15; Oct 16 = 2.74%, Oct 15 = 2.78%, Oct 14 = 2.84%); 4-week trend UP from ~2.52% on Sep 15 to 2.80% (+28bps); status headwind (rising on 4-week basis and above 2% threshold); Oct 20 H.15 reading confirms next scheduled release October 21, 2026.

indicators.name: 2s10s Yield Curve
indicators.note: October 19, 2026: 2s10s spread at +0.38% (+38bps) per FRED T10Y2Y/recessionpulse; Oct 20 data ranges +33 to +38bps across sources (data-provider divergence on intraday timing); 4-week trend DOWN (~+42bps on Sep 19 → +38bps Oct 19 = −4bps flattening); brief intraweek recovery from Oct 16 low of +35bps; status neutral — curve positively sloped but flattening; FOMC Oct 28 hike could compress spread further.

indicators.name: Fed Balance Sheet
indicators.note: WALCL at $6.756T for week ending October 14, 2026 (H.4.1 released Oct 15, 2026; 6,755,639 million per FRED; prior week Oct 7 = $6.748T, +$8B WoW); 4-week trend flat: Sep 23 $6.748T → Oct 14 $6.756T = +$8B (+0.1%); status supportive (flat near post-QT-pause stabilization plateau); next H.4.1 release October 22, 2026 (covers week ending Oct 21).

indicators.name: BTC Funding Rates (perps avg)
indicators.note: BTC weighted 8h perp funding rate at ~0.0079% as of October 20, 2026 (CoinGecko/macro research; down from 0.0100% on Oct 18–19; perpetual open interest ~$67.1B); 30-day trend UP from ~0.0067% on Sep 30 to current level; well below the 0.04% per 8h overheating threshold; status supportive (spot-driven accumulation, no speculative leverage excess).

indicators.name: Stablecoin Dominance
indicators.note: Stablecoin market cap ~$301.4B (DefiLlama Oct 20, 2026; USDT dominance 60.71%) vs total crypto ~$2.90T (CoinLaw Oct 2026); dominance ~10.6%; BTC.D at 59.4% (down from prior 60.2%); 30-day trend flat (Sep 17 est. ~10.5% → Oct 20 ~10.6%); status neutral — stablecoin dominance flat on 30-day basis; headwind condition (rising dom + rising TOTAL simultaneously) not triggered.

upcoming.title: Initial Jobless Claims (week ended October 18, 2026)
upcoming.note: DOL weekly initial jobless claims at 8:30 AM ET for the week ended October 18, 2026 — one of the last major labor data points before the October 28 FOMC decision; a sustained trend above 220K would raise recession risk; carries outsized weight given the September NFP of +29K, hot CPI (3.7% YoY), and hot PPI (6.3% YoY) backdrop heading into the meeting.

upcoming.title: Fed Balance Sheet H.4.1 (week ending October 21, 2026)
upcoming.note: Federal Reserve releases weekly H.4.1 balance sheet data (week ending Oct 21) at 4:30 PM ET; prior reading was $6.76T (Oct 14, 6,755,639 million); any acceleration in asset runoff ahead of the Oct 28 FOMC meeting would be notable; this release will update WALCL from its current flat trend.

upcoming.title: S&P Global US Flash PMI (October 2026)
upcoming.note: S&P Global releases preliminary October 2026 Manufacturing and Services PMI at 9:45 AM ET — first Q4 activity data point, released five days before the FOMC meeting begins; September ISM Manufacturing at 54.5% sets a high bar; a flash manufacturing print below 52 would suggest deceleration and reinforce Fed hold expectations despite hot inflation.

upcoming.title: UMich Consumer Sentiment Final (October 2026)
upcoming.note: University of Michigan releases the final October 2026 Consumer Sentiment Index at 10:00 AM ET; this final print closes out the pre-FOMC consumer confidence picture ahead of the Oct 27–28 meeting; any sharp downward revision would reinforce stagflation concerns given September CPI at 3.7% YoY and still-elevated mortgage rates.

upcoming.title: Conference Board Consumer Confidence (October 2026)
upcoming.note: Conference Board releases October 2026 Consumer Confidence Index at 10:00 AM ET — most recent reading was 89.4 (August 2026); released on the same day FOMC Day 1 begins; a sharp drop would reinforce stagflation concerns heading into the Oct 28 decision, while a hold or uptick would reduce pressure on the Fed to slow its hiking pace.

upcoming.title: FOMC Meeting Begins (Day 1 of 2; decision October 28)
upcoming.note: Federal Reserve October 2026 FOMC 2-day meeting opens; policy decision and press conference on October 28 at 2:00 PM ET; current Fed Funds target 3.75%–4.00% (raised 25bps on Sep 16, 2026); back-to-back inflation shocks — CPI 3.7% YoY (Oct 14) and PPI 6.3% YoY (Oct 15) — and DXY at 101.77 with real yields at 2.80% sustain elevated 25bp hike probability.

upcoming.title: FOMC Rate Decision & Press Conference (October 2026)
upcoming.note: Federal Reserve releases the October 2026 FOMC rate decision at 2:00 PM ET, followed by Chair press conference; current target: 3.75%–4.00%; back-to-back inflation shocks (CPI 3.7% YoY, PPI 6.3% YoY) sustain probability of a 25bp hike to 4.00%–4.25% — which would push DXY above 103 and extend real yield headwinds for risk assets; a hawkish hold is the binary alternative.
